criteria.name: Must-Have Acceptance Criteria Coverage
criteria.description: 100% of Must-have ACs from docs/prd.md are mapped into stories in backlog.json.

scale.3: Every single Must-have AC is covered by a discrete story with explicit refs.
scale.2: All ACs covered, minor duplicate AC reference across two stories.
scale.1: One or more Must-have ACs omitted from backlog.

criteria.name: INVEST Criteria and Story Sizing
criteria.description: Stories satisfy INVEST criteria; no story exceeds 5 story points (1 day of agent work).

scale.3: All stories <= 5 points, sliced by user-visible outcome, testable and independent.
scale.2: Stories sized <= 5 points, minor multi-layer grouping.

criteria.name: Walking Skeleton First Milestone
criteria.description: Story 1 is the walking skeleton defined in architecture.md; zero dependency cycles in the graph.

scale.3: Walking skeleton is the first story; strict DAG dependency structure with zero cycles.
scale.2: Walking skeleton prioritized, minor redundant dependency link.
scale.1: Walking skeleton delayed behind non-critical features.
scale.0: Dependency cycle detected in story graph.

criteria.name: Roster Assignment and Load Balancing
criteria.description: Stories assigned strictly to valid agents from docs/team-plan.json by role; balanced load across parallel seats.

scale.3: All stories assigned to existing agents from roster with balanced distribution across seats.
scale.2: Assigned to valid agents, slight imbalance in point distribution.
scale.1: Story assigned to non-existent agent or wrong role.
scale.0: Unassigned stories or ungrounded agent IDs.

criteria.name: Daily Report Factual Task Integrity
criteria.description: Daily reports cite facts directly from task records; blockers listed first; tokens reconciled with ledger.

scale.3: 100% of reported progress traces directly to task records and token ledger with blockers prioritized.
scale.2: Factual report, minor formatting variance in token summary.
scale.1: Progress reported without corresponding task record update.

criteria.name: Scope and AC Preservation (Must Not Mutate)
criteria.description: Scrum Master preserves PRD scope and acceptance criteria verbatim without inventing, dropping, or rewriting.

scale.3: Scope and ACs preserved with exact verbatim traceability.
scale.2: Preserved, minor addition of clarifying test hint.
scale.1: AC rewritten altering original verification criteria.
scale.0: Scope added or removed without authorization.
